component.name: Stickies
component.summary: Capture and find local sticky notes

description.p: Stickies is a fast, keyboard-first note application for Fedora GNOME that captures text, images, files, and clipboard contents as local Markdown notes.
Notes are stored as plain Markdown files under your local data directory. Text, images, clipboard contents, and dropped files can be captured immediately and searched with full-text matching.

ul.li: Autosaving Markdown editor with syntax highlighting
Full-text search over note bodies, tags, and attachment names
Inline image thumbnails and file attachments
Tags, pinning, trash, restore, and permanent deletion
No network access, accounts, or cloud sync

description.p: Initial v1 release with local notes, Markdown editing, attachments, search, tags, pinning, and trash management.
